title: Jump Game
constraints: Each value is a maximum jump length, so shorter jumps are also allowed.

examples.explanation: Jump 1 step from index 0 to 1, then 3 steps to last index.
Always arrive at index 3 with value 0 — cannot jump further.
The first index is already the last index.

solutionApproaches.title: Dynamic Programming Reachability
solutionApproaches.explanation: Mark an index reachable when a previous reachable index can jump to it; correct but unnecessary.

solutionApproaches.title: Greedy Max Reach
solutionApproaches.explanation: Track the farthest index reachable. If current index exceeds it, return false.
